# Unpause (playunpause.com)

> Fast, dark-mode, zero-popup browser utility for GTA VI console storage checking, Vice City keypad vaults, integer-exact heist splitting, and 9 instant math calculators across COD Warzone, EA Sports FC 27, Minecraft, Roblox, CS2, Valorant, Fortnite, Apex Legends, and GTA Online.

## Core Game Calculators
- [Home (GTA VI + All 10)](https://playunpause.com/): Check GTA VI 212–225 GB SSD fit on PS5 or Xbox in seconds, compare Warzone 300 HP TTK, link Minecraft Nether portals, and solve EA FC 27 tax cleanly free.
- [Preload & SSD Surgery](https://playunpause.com/gta-6/storage): Test if GTA 6 (212 GB PS5 / 225 GB Xbox) fits on Series S, Series X, or PS5 SSDs, pick games to clear, check NZ unlock timing, and export a Preload Spec Card.
- [Safe Keypad Vault](https://playunpause.com/gta-6/safe-codes): Search GTA 6 safe codes by district, play interactive 10-key WebAudio sequences, copy 4-digit codes in one tap, and track cracked doors locally without ads.
- [Squad Heist Splitter](https://playunpause.com/gta-6/heist-split): Split squad heist percentages to an exact 100%, auto-deduct NPC fees, export Crew Payout Slip PNGs to Discord, and model two-character story stock flips.
- [Weeknight Route & Shield](https://playunpause.com/gta-6/night-run): Follow time-boxed 45m/90m/120m GTA 6 weeknight loops on an interactive Leonida waypoint grid and avoid permanent mission lockouts with zero story spoilers.
- [CoD / Warzone TTK](https://playunpause.com/cod-warzone): Compare Season 1 Warzone guns head-to-head at 300/250/200/100 HP with headshot multipliers, open-bolt trigger delays, and 33-weapon Mastery Camo progress.
- [Fortnite XP Pace](https://playunpause.com/fortnite): Calculate daily XP and matches to reach Level 100, Level 140 V-Bucks break-even, or Level 200 Super Styles with Daily Quests, Creative & LEGO.
- [Minecraft 8:1 Linker](https://playunpause.com/minecraft): Convert Overworld & Nether coordinates using exact Java/Bedrock Math.floor rules, test 128-block portal collisions, and triangulate Strongholds in 2 throws.
- [EA FC 27 Tax & SBC](https://playunpause.com/ea-fc-27): Calculate exact 5% EA transfer tax, legal FUT market price-step break-evens, multi-card trading profits, and the exact 11-player SBC Excess-Rating solver.
- [Roblox DevEx USD](https://playunpause.com/roblox): Convert earned Robux at $0.0038/R$ Standard, $0.0035 Legacy, or $0.0054 US Direct Store rates, enforce the 30,000 R$ floor, and price Gamepasses after 30%.
- [CS2 MR12 Economy](https://playunpause.com/cs2): Simulate authentic CS2 MR12 loss tiers ($1,400–$3,400), -1 win step-downs, Level 1 pistol losses, T +$800 bomb plants, and 5-player rifle drop balancing.
- [Valorant Buy & RR](https://playunpause.com/valorant): Plan Valorant buys across Light (400), Regen (650), Heavy (1,000) shields & Vandal/Outlaw against 1,900–2,900 loss minimums, plus simulate Ranked RR climbs.
- [Apex Packs & RP](https://playunpause.com/apex-legends): Calculate earned free Apex Packs across Prestige Tiers 0–3 (up to 544 packs), track 500-pack Heirloom pity, and estimate Ranked RP promotion games free.
- [GTA Online Cayo](https://playunpause.com/gta-online): Calculate Cayo Perico net payouts with Pavel 2%, Fence 10%, $100K setup fee, +10% Hard Mode, Gold/Cocaine bag fills, and mandatory 15% crew floors.
